title: Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning
summary: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics.
